# Cosmopolitan Philippines

> > Cosmopolitan Philippines is a leading women's lifestyle magazine covering beauty, fashion, health, wellness, and celebrity culture for Filipino women.

The digital platform features beauty tutorials, skincare guides, fashion trends, celebrity news, and K-pop content. Content creators include Rachelle Bravo, Kylie Verzosa, and a team of lifestyle journalists covering brands like Rare Beauty, Burt's Bees, and celebrity culture including BTS and international stars.

## Key Topics

- Beauty & Cosmetics
- Skincare Routines
- Makeup Tutorials
- Fashion Trends
- Celebrity Style
- K-Pop & BTS
- Rare Beauty
- Hair Care
- Women's Fashion
- Shopping Guides
- Health & Wellness
- Celebrity Beauty
- Filipino Lifestyle
- Beauty Products
- Fashion Tips

## Beauty & Cosmetics

- [Beauty | Cosmopolitan Philippines](https://old.cosmo.ph/beauty?ref=nav_v2): Beauty tips, products & secrets covering hair, skin, makeup & more

## Fashion & Style

- [Style | Cosmopolitan Philippines](https://old.cosmo.ph/style?ref=nav_v2): Fashion trends, celebrity style & shopping guides for women

## Health & Wellness

- [Health | Cosmopolitan Philippines](https://old.cosmo.ph/health?ref=nav_v2): Health news, wellness advice, fitness & weight-loss tips

## Video Content

- [Cosmo Videos | Cosmopolitan Philippines](https://old.cosmo.ph/videos?ref=nav_v2): Celebrity interviews, makeup tutorials, workouts & K-Drama content
